title: Message-ID lookup is case-sensitive; RFC 5536 requires case-insensitive matching
description: transit/peering/ingestion.rs passes message_id directly to msgid_map.lookup_by_msgid() without normalization. Two peers sending <ABC@example.com> and <abc@example.com> produce duplicate articles. RFC 5536 requires case-insensitive Message-ID comparison. Normalize to lowercase at ingress.
